description:
This collection hosts the underlying data for the [DRE Atlas Planning Platform](https://dre.energydata.info), hosted on [energydata.info](https://energydata.info) — produced by [VIDA](https://vida.place), commissioned and funded by the [Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP)](https://www.esmap.org), the [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/energy), and the [International Finance Corporation (IFC)](https://www.ifc.org).

Settlement-level data for distributed renewable energy (DRE) planning, covering over 1.9 million settlements across 58 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, the Pacific, and the Americas. Each settlement carries 50+ attributes covering buildings, population, electricity access, grid infrastructure, energy demand, solar potential, road access, social infrastructure, wealth, agriculture, and security.

- **Interactive platform:** [dre.energydata.info](https://dre.energydata.info) — [User guide](https://vidaplace.notion.site/dre-atlas-user-guide)
- **Technical documentation:** [DRE Atlas Technical Documentation (PDF)](https://dre.energydata.info/static/DRE-Atlas-Technical-Documentation.pdf)

partition:keys.name: country_iso
partition:keys.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, one GeoParquet file per country.

table:columns.name: geohash
table:columns.description: Unique identifier (based on coordinates)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Settlement boundary polygon (WGS 84).

table:columns.name: lat
table:columns.description: Latitude of settlement centroid (EPSG:4326)

table:columns.name: lon
table:columns.description: Longitude of settlement centroid (EPSG:4326)

table:columns.name: village_name
table:columns.description: Name of the settlement derived from reverse geocoding, if available - note that in some cases this might refer to the name of a larger settlement in the surrounding or an administrative sub-division, and official or local names can be different.

table:columns.name: admin_cgaz_1
table:columns.description: Name of the administrative sub-division level 1 in which the settlement is located (display name according to country conventions). We do not endorse or guarantee the accuracy of any country boundaries shown, which may be subject to dispute or variation.

table:columns.name: admin_cgaz_2
table:columns.description: Name of the administrative sub-division level 2 in which the settlement is located (display name according to country conventions). We do not endorse or guarantee the accuracy of any country boundaries shown, which may be subject to dispute or variation.

table:columns.name: hull_area
table:columns.description: Total area of the settlement

table:columns.name: building_density_percent
table:columns.description: Building density as settlement area covered by building footprints (in %)

table:columns.name: num_buildings
table:columns.description: Total number of buildings (min. 15 m2 footprint size, excluding small structures) within the settlement. Note that in few countries buildings from OpenStreetMap as well as WorldPop building counts layers were used in addition for better coverage.

table:columns.name: large_buildings
table:columns.description: Number of buildings > 200 m2 (footprint size)

table:columns.name: medium_buildings
table:columns.description: Number of buildings 120-200 m2 (footprint size)

table:columns.name: small_buildings
table:columns.description: Number of buildings 15-120 m2 (footprint size)

table:columns.name: very_small_structures
table:columns.description: Number of buildings < 15 m2 (footprint size) - these are typically non-inhabited built-up structures which are not relevant for electrification (e.g. animal sheds, outdoor kitchens, storage space), and are therefore not included in the total building count

table:columns.name: population
table:columns.description: Population estimates by VIDA derived from building counts and urban/rural classifications based on the Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL), calibrated against World Bank sub-national population statistics.

table:columns.name: closest_distance_water
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest river or lake

table:columns.name: main_road_access
table:columns.description: Yes/true, if the settlement is within 500 meter of a main road (see below)

table:columns.name: dist_main_road_km
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest main road (types: motorway, trunk, primary, secondary - these are mostly paved and/or well-maintained main transportation routes)

table:columns.name: nearest_hub_name
table:columns.description: Name of the closest regional hub, if available (see below)

table:columns.name: dist_nearest_hub_km
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest regional hub (populated places of types: city, town)

table:columns.name: num_education_facilities
table:columns.description: Number of education facilities within 500m of the settlement (OSM: schools, colleges, universities, kindergartens, language schools, and general educational institutions)

table:columns.name: has_education_facility
table:columns.description: Yes/true, if at least one education facility (see above) is within 500m of the settlement. Not displayed in site details, but available as a filter and in raw data..

table:columns.name: num_health_facilities
table:columns.description: Number of healthcare facilities within 500m of the settlement (OSM: doctors, dentists, clinics, hospitals, pharmacies and other general healthcare facilities)

table:columns.name: has_health_facility
table:columns.description: Yes/true, if at least one healthcare facility (see above) is within 500m of the settlement. Not displayed in site details, but available as a filter and in raw data.

table:columns.name: mean_rwi
table:columns.description: Mean relative wealth index within the settlement (index derived from survey data, satellite imagery, connectivity, and other geodata) - note that not all settlements and countries are covered by this index.

table:columns.name: distance_to_existing_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest existing transmission grid line (unknown or mixed voltages) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: has_nightlight
table:columns.description: Yes/true, if settlement overlap with nightlight areas is > 0 % (areas where light was detected by night from NASA's VIIRS nighttime light data over a period of one year - Sep 2022 to Aug 2023)

table:columns.name: overlap_percentage
table:columns.description: Share of settlement area overlapping with nightlight area (areas where light was detected by night from NASA's VIIRS nighttime light data over a period of one year - Sep 2022 to Aug 2023)

table:columns.name: distance_to_gridlight_targets
table:columns.description: Distance to closest nightlight area (where light was detected by night from NASA's VIIRS nighttime light data over a period of one year - Sep 2022 to Aug 2023)

table:columns.name: pv_value
table:columns.description: Longterm yearly average (1994-2015) of potential PV electricity production under optimum conditions

table:columns.name: crop_types
table:columns.description: The five dominant crops grown in the administrative subdivision level 2. SPAM data is not available in selected countries / subdivisions.

table:columns.name: ag_area
table:columns.description: Agricultural (harvested) area within administrative subdivision level 2. SPAM data is not available in selected countries / subdivisions.

table:columns.name: ag_value
table:columns.description: Total crop value within administrative subdivision level 2. SPAM data is not available in selected countries / subdivisions.

table:columns.name: ag_yield
table:columns.description: Total crop yield within administrative subdivision level 2. SPAM data is not available in selected countries / subdivisions.

table:columns.name: ag_value_area
table:columns.description: Total crop value per area within administrative subdivision level 2. SPAM data is not available in selected countries / subdivisions.

table:columns.name: fatalities_within_25km
table:columns.description: Number of fatalities from armed conflicts from 2020-2022 within 25 km of the settlement by conflict type (battles, riots, violence against civilians, explosions) - in selected countries, less years are available as displayed on the platform.

table:columns.name: fatalities_within_50km
table:columns.description: Number of fatalities from armed conflicts from 2020-2022 within 50 km of the settlement by conflict type (battles, riots, violence against civilians, explosions) - in selected countries, less years are available as displayed on the platform.

table:columns.name: total_incidents_50km
table:columns.description: Number of incidents (armed conflicts of types battles, riots, violence against civilians, explosions) from 2020-2022 within 20 km of the settlement- in selected countries, less years are available as displayed on the platform.

table:columns.name: security_risk
table:columns.description: Security indicator based on number of fatalities as described above: high: 1+ fatalities within 25 (or 10) km, medium: 1+ fatalities within 50 (or 25) km, low: all other

table:columns.name: num_connections
table:columns.description: Number of estimated potential connections corresponding to the total number of buildings (min. 15 m2 footprint size)

table:columns.name: demand
table:columns.description: Estimated energy demand of all potential connections / buildings (min. 15 m2 footprint size), with the following assumptions: large buildings: 1,100 Wh/day, medium buildings: 650 Wh/day, small buildings: 10 % with 650 Wh/day & 90 % with 300 Wh/day

table:columns.name: demand_connection
table:columns.description: Mean energy demand per connection

table:columns.name: country_iso
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the settlement geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).

table:columns.name: distance_to_planned_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest planned transmission grid line (unknown or mixed voltages) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: fatalities_within_10km
table:columns.description: Number of fatalities from armed conflicts from 2020-2022 within 10 km of the settlement by conflict type (battles, riots, violence against civilians, explosions) - in selected countries, less years are available as displayed on the platform.

table:columns.name: fatalities_within_20km
table:columns.description: Number of fatalities from armed conflicts from 2020-2022 within 20 km of the settlement by conflict type (battles, riots, violence against civilians, explosions) - in selected countries, less years are available as displayed on the platform.

table:columns.name: total_incidents_20km
table:columns.description: Number of incidents (armed conflicts of types battles, riots, violence against civilians, explosions) from 2020-2022 within 20 km of the settlement- in selected countries, less years are available as displayed on the platform.

table:columns.name: distance_to_substation
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest substation - note that public substation data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_existing_mv_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest existing medium-voltage (MV) transmission grid line (MV classification according to original data) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_existing_hv_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest existing high-voltage (HV) transmission grid line (MV classification according to original data) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_planned_hv_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest planned high-voltage (HV) transmission grid line (MV classification according to original data) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_transformer
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest transformer - note that public transformer data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest existing or planned transmission grid line (unknown or mixed voltages) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_existing_unidentified_transmission_lines
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest existing transmission grid line (unknown voltage) - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.

table:columns.name: distance_to_existing_transmission_lines_uc
table:columns.description: Distance to the closest existing transmission grid line under construction - note that public grid data can be outdated / inaccurate.
